record.hypothesis: Replace absolute padded-column position IDs with cumulative nonpadding position IDs, leaving padding at zero. Short histories then share position representations according to observed sequence order, potentially improving transfer across the predominantly short histories. Retain history truncation, causal gated HSTU attention and final-real-position readout. Apply the identical position rule during training and prediction; leave features, embedding tables, scoring, loss and optimizer unchanged.

The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so training and inference use the identical rule without checkpoint shape changes. History truncation, final-position readout, gated attention, scoring, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
